offering_description.value: Owns and markets lifestyle apparel and related products under brands such as Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was and Duck Head. Sells to consumers through its own stores, e-commerce sites and restaurants, and to department and specialty stores. Products are designed in-house and made by third-party contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: men's and women's sportswear; resort and casual apparel; dresses; swimwear; accessories and home goods

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers buying apparel at full-price stores, outlets, online and restaurants; B2B: department stores, specialty retailers and off-price retailers buying wholesale

end_markets.value: apparel; fashion retail; resort and lifestyle; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: apparel and accessories sold direct to consumers and wholesale; licensing or royalties: royalty income from licensing brand names to third parties; service fees: food and beverage sales at company-owned restaurants
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded apparel made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers; retailer: operates own brand stores, outlets and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with stores and licensees in Canada, Asia, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean

specialization.value: related lines: several lifestyle apparel brands sharing consumers, design, sourcing and channels, plus brand restaurants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: full-price brand stores, outlets and restaurants; online: brand e-commerce websites; third-party retail: department stores, specialty shops and off-price retailers; partners / resellers: international licensees and distributors
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customs and tariff rules, product labeling and safety, labor and sourcing compliance, restaurant food and alcohol regulation
